headline: Fort Hays State ends Lincoln's unbeaten season
dek: Lincoln fell at home to Fort Hays State on Sunday after drawing Findlay on Friday, taking its only defeat of a season that brought sixteen wins and five draws. Fort Hays State had beaten Maryville on Friday as well, and no match remains on the schedule.
displaced_by: Lincoln's unbeaten season ended in a home loss to Fort Hays State after a draw with Findlay, and Maryville also lost to Fort Hays State.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist scored 45 goals, more than either Drury or Indianapolis near the top of the table, yet conceded 36 and lost seven times; goals alone did not carry a program into the upper tier.

wire.line: Lincoln's sixteen-win season ended with a single defeat, leaving no unbeaten program in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two August matches past their date carry no result, and both belong to Drury.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Drury has lost five times this season: at home to Oklahoma Christian in August, away at Missouri S&T in September, at home to Lincoln and Missouri-St. Louis in October, and at home to Maryville in November.
